events.description: Carol Willick asks whether Ross Geller and Susan Bunch are here yet.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller and Susan Bunch are not here now.
Rachel Green tells Carol Willick not to worry right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green and Carol Willick are going to find Ross Geller and Susan Bunch.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green, Dr. Franzblau, and Carol Willick are here for Carol Willick right now.
Rachel Green says Dr. Franzblau was telling Rachel Green about Paris.
Rachel Green says Paris sounds fascinating.
Dr. Franzblau says Paris really was fascinating.
Dr. Franzblau says there was a great little pastry shop right by Dr. Franzblau's hotel in Paris.
Dr. Franzblau tells Carol Willick to go ahead and keep going right now.
